tagline: Understand your legal problem. Know your next step.
subline: YamaLaw helps citizens navigate legal processes, organize documents and evidence, find legal assistance, and track their case journey.

landing.flow: Problem → Understand → Prepare → Connect → Track → Resolve
landing.disclaimer: YamaLaw provides legal information and workflow support — not legal advice. Always consult a qualified lawyer for advice about your matter.

hero.sub: Describe your problem in your own words. YamaLaw classifies it, builds a legal journey, tells you exactly what to prepare, and tracks your matter from intake to resolution.

quickAccount.title: Create Your Account
quickAccount.body: Sign up in under a minute. No payment details, no paperwork, no middlemen.

quickDescribe.title: Describe Your Problem
quickDescribe.body: Write in plain language. YamaLaw works out which authority applies and what happens next.

quickExplore.title: Explore the Workflow
quickExplore.body: See how journeys, readiness scoring, evidence custody and legal aid fit together end to end.

how.sub: Four steps from a problem you can describe to a matter you can track.
how.s1Body: Choose your role — citizen, lawyer, judge or police — and verify your email.
how.s2Body: Write what happened. YamaLaw classifies it against twelve legal categories automatically.
how.s3Body: Work through your stored journey, upload documents and evidence, and watch readiness climb.
how.s4Body: Find legal aid, open a case, assign a lawyer, and follow hearings to resolution.
how.cta: Ready to understand your next step?

features.title: Everything you need to navigate a legal matter
features.sub: Not a chatbot. A continuity platform where every stage, document and deadline is stored.
features.journeyBody: Keyword classification plus reusable journey templates across twelve categories. Stages, tasks and requirements are persisted, not regenerated as text.
features.readinessBody: A weighted score from documents, evidence, information, prerequisites, jurisdiction and preparation. You can always see exactly why it reads the way it does.
features.evidenceBody: SHA-256 on upload, integrity verification on demand, full access history and tamper flagging for every file.
features.aidBody: Configurable eligibility rules with DLSA and NGO providers, plus the next action to take for each.
features.researchBody: Search the YamaLaw legal library, inspect the matched source, bookmark and attach to a case. No invented citations — it says “Source not found” instead.
features.multilingualBody: Runs with AI disabled. English, हिन्दी and मराठी interface with plain-language legal terms.

trust.title: Transparent by design
trust.sub: Your documents and evidence stay yours. We show our reasoning instead of hiding it.
trust.securityBody: Every file is SHA-256 hashed on upload and re-verifiable at any time.
trust.procedureBody: Jurisdiction-aware journeys so you see the steps that actually apply to you.
trust.rolesBody: Separate portals for citizens, lawyers, judges, police and administrators.
trust.readinessBody: Readiness scores show the weight of each area and what is missing.
trust.freeBody: No paywall, no per-case fee, no feature held hostage.
trust.privacyBody: Documents are processed and stored by your own deployment.

roadmap.sub: Active work that extends the workflow-first approach.
roadmap.languagesBody: Expanding the interface and legal-term glossary beyond English, हिन्दी and मराठी, with Indic-first input.
roadmap.forensicsBody: Automatic classification of uploaded documents against the journey requirements that produced them.
roadmap.hearingsBody: Browser-based video rooms attached to the case timeline so remote appearances do not need a third-party application.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you might want to know before you begin.
faq.q1Answer: YamaLaw is a citizen legal access and case continuity platform. It helps you understand a legal problem, determine which authority applies, prepare and preserve documents and evidence, find legal aid, and track your matter from intake to resolution. The workflow is the product — every stage is stored rather than regenerated as chat text.
faq.q2Answer: Yes. There is no paywall and no per-case fee. It runs on free-tier infrastructure and works with AI features switched off, so core functionality does not depend on a paid model provider.
faq.q3Answer: Citizens are the primary audience, and lawyers, judges, police officers and administrators each get a portal designed around their own responsibilities. Role-based access control is enforced on both the server and the client.
faq.q4: Is this a replacement for a lawyer?
faq.q4Answer: No. YamaLaw provides legal information and workflow support, not legal advice. It helps you arrive at a lawyer's or court's door prepared, but nothing it produces is a substitute for qualified legal advice about your specific matter.
faq.q5: What happens to my documents and evidence?
faq.q5Answer: Every upload is hashed with SHA-256 at the point of upload and can be re-verified later; any mismatch is flagged. Files are processed and stored by your own deployment rather than being sent to a third party, and every access is recorded in the chain of custody.
faq.q6: How can I report a technical issue?
faq.q6Answer: Open an issue on the project's GitHub repository. Include what you expected, what happened instead, and your browser — it is the fastest route to a fix.
